name: Life Management
description: My life is complicated! Keeping everything on track is hard.
prompt_template:
Thank you for helping me with life matters! Here are some things about me to get us started:
Professional
* I am data and technology generalist. I was a TPM and then PM at a media company for a long time, but I also do my own data analysis and full-stack app prototyping, now with a focus on AI.
* I am currently freelance but working primarily on a startup where I went from being a paid freelancer to a 20% owner of the company (this was both planned and because of budget limitations). 
* I have done a lot of work in sales and marketing. My current startup involvement is as head of growth for an AI-for-BI startup called Dashbud, where I have rebuilt their website (using Astro and Sanity) and am working on a content program as we get closer to a launch of the app. The content program means I need to stay on top of news in the industry (data analytics, AI) and write. I also want to start writing for my own AI-enabled data consulting practice, which I plan to launch soon.
* My other client is a law firm founded by a friend. BDH (Josh) has hired me to analyze Josh's incredibly successful biz dev practices over the last 15 years through an in-depth analysis of his email using a variety of data techniques an some AI. Our goal is to help him run his practice better and possibly to offer the service to similarly positioned law partners as a product/services company, as 50-50 partners. 
* Things are going well in terms of what I'm working but not cash payment. My wife and I have assets, and she has some cash, but my income in the last year has been pretty spotty. She's also working on realigning her career, so we need to make more money. If I got a job offer for a position earning $200K all-in, similar to my last position, I would take it and put . But I believe the job market is pretty weak right now and I haven't had time to test it. 

Personal/business
I have a lot of personal stuff to take care of. 
* My mom is 91 and lives independently; I track her medications and aides, and visit her weekly. 
* I own a rental property in Cambridge (I'm in Brooklyn)
* my wife and I are looking to rent out my mom's place upstate (needs a cleanout and some light improvements); 
* We are renovating and landscaping our new-ish place in LI, which has solid earning potential (it has beachfront and a view of the water) but we also love staying at. We spend a lot of time there (and are doing a lot of the landscaping work ourselves, since we don't have the cash right now to pay for it) but we'd like to rent it out a couple of months a year. Two months during the high season would pay our expenses -- mortgage, taxes, utilities. Our renovations are close to a state where we should be able to make it available.
* We are trying to have kids, but we are in our 40s. We are using a donor and possibly will need a surrogate. It's a ridiculously complicated and difficult (emotionally, organizationally) process.
* I'm an avid runner and a bit of an intellectual/writer manque. I have taken a couple of months off running to deal with everything else -- I was also kind of burnt out after running a lot last year (though I also broke 3 in the marathon and PRed in the half). I have interesting and/or funny ideas and I like to write them down. I'm hoping to put some recent ideas on AI into a series for promoting my own tech/AI/data practice.
